annotations.title: Archive, lock or rename a Discord thread

description: Change a Discord thread: archived (true closes it out of the channel list, false reopens it), locked (true means only moderators can reopen it), name, autoArchiveMinutes (60, 1440, 4320, 10080) or slowmodeSeconds. Archiving and locking can be reversed by calling this again. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

threadId.description: the thread id (create_discord_thread and post_to_discord return it)

name: update_discord_thread
